differences: Square-cell graph geometry, stable global axes, and primary chart-handle interaction are implemented in preview and persistence.
Fast swept pixel erasing is stored as single-stroke masks; it does not split a thick source stroke.
Editor, PNG, PDF, high-resolution capture, and SVG use matching chart and erase semantics.
The final debug APK was installed with ADB on the connected Mi tablet without clearing app data.
A manual stylus smoke pass remains useful for tactile confirmation on the physical display.
suggestions: Manually verify a 2 px eraser channel through a 20 px stroke at 100%, 200%, and 400% zoom.
Manually verify all four graph resize handles after grow/shrink on the Mi tablet.
visual_verdict.reasoning: The fixed logical-pixel compositor is now wired into the editor and exports, protected by Robolectric pixel assertions and graph interaction regression tests. The final build and complete unit suite passed, the architecture review approved it, and the APK is present on the requested device.
